content: अनङ्ग {%a.%} [<sab>न˚ ब˚</sab>] .²1 Bodiless, without a body; formless, incorporeal; त्वमनङ्गः कथमक्षता रतिः <ls>Ku. 4. 9</ls>. .²2 Different from the body. .²3 Without a supplement or auxiliary. .{@-ङ्गः@} .²1 Cupid (the bodiless one; so called from his having been reduced to ashes by Śiva with the fire of his third eye, when he tried to seduce the Godʼs mind towards Pārvatī for the birth of a deliverer of the Gods from Tāraka.) .²2 Wind. .²3 A goblin. .²4 A shadow, <ab>cf.</ab> अनङ्गे मन्मथे वायौ पिशाचच्छाययोरपि <ls>Nm.</ls> .{@-ङ्गम्@} .²1 Sky, air, ether. .²2 The mind (आकाशस्य निरवयवत्वात् न्यायवैशेषिकमते चित्तस्य अगुणत्वेन तस्य तथात्वम्).
